title: Concept: Base element points at another origin
description: The base element silently rewrites the resolution of every relative URL in the document, including form actions and script sources. A cross-origin base therefore turns the page into a delivery vehicle for the other host, and no per-link check in the page would notice.
applicability: Responses that render a base element from configuration or from a request value.
risk: The caller redirects the page navigation, form submissions and script loads to a host under their control.
